_note: Yantra's own words in the 3D bench (beam), kit (circuit) and stand (pendulum) (the goal, readouts and controls are the beam law's shared words in data/play/engine-words.json, the same the 2D board twin shows). Hints are lesson content in the child's language (en / hinglish / hi): how to act, never a verdict, no praise, no pressure. {slot} = a value the law gives.

place.en: Tap a tile to stand a mirror there

turn.en: Drag round the mirror to turn it
turn.hinglish: Sheeshe ke charon or khiskao: ghoomega
turn.hi: शीशे के चारों ओर खिसकाओ: घूमेगा

pick.en: Tap a mirror to pick it

wire.en: Drag from one screw to another
wire.hinglish: Ek pench se doosre tak kheencho
wire.hi: एक पेंच से दूसरे तक खींचो

cut.en: Tap a wire's knot to cut it
cut.hinglish: Taar ki gaanth chhuo: kat jayega
cut.hi: तार की गाँठ छुओ: कट जाएगा

length.en: Drag the bob up or down

count.en: Tap each time it comes back
count.hinglish: Har baar wapas aaye to chhuo
count.hi: हर बार वापस आए तो छुओ
